newsitem.title: USA: Airline alliance may offer shared offices - NYT.
newsitem.headline: Airline alliance may offer shared offices - NYT.

text.p: An alliance among a variety of airlines is expected to include shared ticket offices and airport operations, according to the New York Times.
The Times in Wednesday's edition said the alliance also was expected to include jointly purchased supplies.
The alliance among United Airlines, Deutsche Lufthansa AG, Air Canada, Thai Airways International Ltd and Scandinavian Airlines System were expected to announce their plan Wednesday.

The airlines involved in what is known as Star Alliance are searching for ways to save money and increase revenues. Their efforts may include coordinating flight schedules and reservation systems as well as shared storing of aircraft parts.
